dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Blessings from the Dendro Archon. I hope all our patients will get well soon.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: I'm just an intern. I still have a lot to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: It is both my job and my wish to protect and help the weak.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Stronger people are often under the spotlight, but medics should care more for weaker patients.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata might have the same vision as she led the researchers to build Amurta.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
